subject: Web Development
title: Preloading and Resource Hints
description: A 60-second lesson on Preloading and Resource Hints.

hook.text: Browsers discover resources as they parse HTML. What if they could start earlier?

buildup.text: Resource hints like preload, prefetch, and preconnect give the browser a head start.

discovery.text: Preload fetches critical resources immediately. Prefetch downloads things for the next page.

twist.text: Overusing hints wastes bandwidth. Loading everything early helps nothing if most goes unused.

climax.text: Strategic hints can cut seconds off load times. Careless ones make performance worse.

punchline.text: Hints work best when used sparingly.

quiz.question: What does the 'prefetch' hint do?
options: Downloads resources for the next page
